notes: Start point: culturetrust.org returned an empty page on both fetches, so the project list was read from the CultureWorks directory (cultureworksphila.org, fiscal-sponsorship/fiscally-sponsored-projects, 86 entries). CultureWorks Greater Philadelphia runs the CultureTrust program, and sources give different project counts (80 vs 90 plus). Budget: all 60 fetches and 1 of 4 searches used, so 22 linked sites were not read and are in leads_only. Results: 36 publish, 3 hide (out_of_scope), 3 out_of_area, and 8 checked groups dropped without a record: CommonSoul Communications (contact only, no dated activity), ENA Ensemble (no way in, no dated activity), iMPeRFeCT Gallery (exhibitions only, no address or hours), Journey On Education (no way in on the home page), LGBTQ+ Editors Association (no Philadelphia presence shown), Practice Space Collective (no offerings visible), Run Boy Run Productions (last dated item 2017, no way in), and Theater of Witness (screenings by email only). Three entries are broken or unreachable (see blocked). Eight entries are social-only and two have no link (see leads_only and below). Featured names with no link: Glass Commons, Philly Drum Project, Future of Food Philadelphia, and Raymond Center (probably the Raymond Farm Center record, a duplicate). Many sponsored projects list 1315 Walnut St (Suite 300 or 320), which is the sponsor's office; these are not recorded as meeting places. Kept published for reviewer decision: NEPCA (status dormant, newest dated item July 2022). Low confidence: Actívate Stories, Casa de Duende, GameOn!, Keeping Society, Onyx Valley, Past Present Projects, Operation Save Our City, Our Market Project, Get Fresh Daily, and Young Artist Program (footer dated 2021). Philly Bluegrass's Center City jam RSVP email is a host's personal address and was not recorded; its Doylestown and Perkasie jams are outside the city. The Thread's site says it is not a helpline. GameOn!'s email is obscured and not recorded. Redirects followed: activate-media.org to activatestories.org, and the Run Boy Run wix page to runboyrunproductions.com. Paddle type for RiverWays is not stated; kayaking is the closest tag.

records.name: Philadelphia Latino Arts & Film Festival (PHLAFF)
records.summary: A community film and arts festival that shows Latino films and arts. Its People's Cinema Club is a weekly film series at the Village of Industry and Art in Center City.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a Tuesday screening, volunteer or intern, or submit a film for the festival.

schedule.text: People's Cinema Club screenings on Tuesdays at 6:30 pm. The 2027 festival runs May 30 to July 4, 2027.

locations.label: Village of Industry and Art, Center City

cost.text: Tickets are sold on Eventbrite. Prices are not listed on the home page.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for a Tuesday screening, or use the volunteer and intern page.
first_step.basis: Public ticketed screenings and a volunteer route are listed.

records.notes: The volunteer, submissions and feedback pages were not read. No email or phone on the home page. The Latino community tag describes who the festival focuses on, not an entry rule.
_held_reasons: own_words: summary shares 8 words in a row with a source: “people's cinema club is a weekly film series”
